description: This Java class defines a response type for handling errors in connectivity commands within the Eclipse Ditto project. It wraps exceptions related to runtime errors during command processing and supports serialization/deserialization to and from JSON.

classes.name: ConnectivityErrorResponse
classes.description: An immutable class representing an error response for connectivity commands, wrapping a DittoRuntimeException and supporting JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a ConnectivityErrorResponse from a DittoRuntimeException, using its headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes a ConnectivityErrorResponse from a JSON string or object, extracting the embedded exception.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets new DittoHeaders for the response, returning a new instance.
